items.title: Speak Ahead Academy
items.hook: Speak English with confidence in real-life situations
items.text: Build the confidence and speaking skills you need for work, interviews, business and everyday conversations. Learn to express your ideas clearly, speak naturally, improve pronunciation and use English with confidence.
items.details:
## Speak English with confidence
Speak Ahead Academy is a spoken English academy for adults who understand English but hesitate when they speak.

## Full course
- Live spoken English classes on Zoom, taught in Manipuri
- Practice in the Speak Ahead app after class

Speak Ahead Academy helps adults who understand English but struggle to speak confidently. The focus is not only on learning English—it is on learning how to actually use English when you need to speak.

Job-Ready English Full Course

A practical spoken-English program designed to help learners communicate more clearly and confidently in real situations.

What you will develop

• Spoken English confidence
• Real-life conversation skills
• Clear pronunciation and natural speech
• Sentence-building and speaking patterns
• Vocabulary for everyday communication
• Essential grammar for speaking correctly
• Listening and response skills
• The ability to explain ideas clearly
• Interview and workplace communication
• Professional communication skills
• Confidence in phone calls and conversations
• Strategies for speaking when you forget a word

Learn through practice

The course focuses on active speaking rather than simply studying English rules. Learners practise speaking, recording their answers, completing activities, taking tests and applying what they learn to realistic situations.

Real-life English

Practice English for situations such as:

• Job interviews
• Workplace conversations
• Introducing yourself
• Speaking with customers and colleagues
• Phone calls
• Asking and answering questions
• Expressing opinions
• Explaining problems
• Giving information
• Everyday conversations
• Professional communication

Speak, practise and improve

Speak Ahead Academy combines guided lessons with practical speaking activities. Learners get opportunities to speak, listen, practise, review their performance and gradually become more comfortable producing English on their own.

The goal is not to make learners memorize complicated English. The goal is to help them turn the English they know into English they can actually speak.

Who is this for?

This course is especially useful for adults who can understand or read basic English but hesitate, freeze, translate in their head, struggle to find words, or lack confidence when speaking.

Whether you want to communicate better at work, prepare for interviews, handle everyday conversations or simply become more confident in English, the course is designed around practical speaking.

The Speak Ahead approach

Learn → Practise → Speak → Improve → Speak with confidence.

Speak Ahead Academy is built around one simple idea: knowing English is not enough. You need to be able to use it when it matters.

items.title: Flagged by an AI detector? You wrote it. Let's prove it.
items.hook: Got flagged by an AI detector? Let's prove you wrote it.
items.text: A calm 48-hour plan with a little app that builds your proof step by step, a detector facts sheet, and kind reply templates. Simple English.
items.details:
## Accused of using AI when you wrote it yourself?
You wrote your essay. Then an AI detector flagged it, and now your teacher or university wants an answer. This kit helps you reply calmly in the next 48 hours, with real proof of your writing process.

## What's inside
- A calm 48-hour plan: what to do first, what to send, and what not to do yet
- A small app that builds your proof step by step: drafts, version history, notes and sources
- A detector facts sheet in simple English
- Kind, clear reply templates for your teacher or academic integrity office

## Why AI detectors get it wrong
AI detectors guess. They can flag real human writing, especially simple, clear writing or writing by non-native English speakers. In a Stanford study, AI detectors marked more than half of the essays written by non-native English speakers as AI-written. OpenAI withdrew its own AI text detector in 2023 because of its low accuracy.

## Who it is for
Students at school, college or university, in any country, who wrote their work themselves and were flagged by Turnitin, GPTZero or another AI detector.

## Good to know
This kit is not legal advice and cannot promise an outcome. It helps you show your real work clearly and calmly.

items.title: Got an IRS letter saying you owe more? Breathe. There's a plan.
items.hook: Got a scary IRS letter? Here's a calm plan.
items.text: The CP2000 Rescue Kit: a phone app plus a 19-page guide to find what didn't match, gather your proof and send your reply on time. Not tax advice.
items.details:
## Got a CP2000 notice from the IRS?
A CP2000 says the income on your tax return does not match what employers, banks or other payers reported to the IRS. It is not a bill and not an audit. It is a proposal: you can agree, partly agree or disagree.

## The deadline matters
Your reply date is printed on the notice. It is usually 30 days from the date of the notice, or 60 days if you live outside the United States. If you need more time, you can ask the IRS before the deadline. If you do not reply, the IRS can send a Statutory Notice of Deficiency (CP3219A).

## What's inside the kit
- A phone app that walks you through your notice, one step at a time
- A 19-page guide in simple English
- Help to find what didn't match, gather your proof and send your reply on time

## Who it is for
People in the USA who got a CP2000 and want a calm, clear plan for their reply.

## Good to know
This kit is not tax advice. For a complex case, talk to a tax professional.
